answer: The question is not how to spot a clone but how to make one expensive. Conferred scaffolding inspector warrant with scaffolding inspectors standing answers it: a warrant inspectors confirm after erection audits, so the nebula of a hundred clones is a hundred times the nebula of one. One honest agent pays once and moves on. A farm pays per clone, and the spiral compounds: ten clones need ten proofs, a hundred need a hundred. Every clone is charged full price a second time, a tenth time, a hundredth time; the hollow is the reason the farm either stays tiny or collapses.
